The repressed sadist in me was rather pleased to see Fashion TV throw caution to the wind. Their raunchy Midnight Hot segment has been moved from the obvious midnight slot to 9.30 pm. Dressed in a tantalising negligee, a seemingly French model extolled the virtues of the derriere, which she insisted was far more appealing than the bosom. I was half-expecting to see pictures of the FTV India office being burnt the next day or the channel being pulled down, but I am still wondering why neither happened. They were, after all, broadcasting 'pornography', which would obviously entice our offspring to rape. If this argument is considered laughable, then only feminism can explain the furore over the lack of slip and excess of hip. But if we are to advocate a feminist approach, common sense dictates that the first casualty should be the K brand of family dramas, where the length of the blouse-sleeve dictates how good or bad a female character really is.
